review_notes: Source-first principal family: reversal-aware tests for accrual-based earnings management. Table 2 evaluates specification using randomly selected management years; seeded-power Figures 1–2 evaluate one-year Healy reversal modeling. These are central contexts for the same contribution, with the full joint two-year equation across five coequal accrual-control models and the distinct one-year Healy equation retained.

For Table 2 the five Healy, Jones, Modified Jones, DD, and McNichols models are full joint Equation (5) specifications. The reported b=0, b−c=0, and b−c−d=0 statistics are restrictions on the same fitted equation, not separate nested regressions.

The performance-matched residual t-tests and Panel C serial-correlation summaries are not regressions in the selected inventory. The AAER application and characteristics-correlated tests are separate validation/follow-up contexts, not this principal testing family.

CF has conflicting supplied-paper definitions: Section 3.2.4 states earnings before extraordinary items minus DAP, whereas the Table 2 note states ib minus WC_ACC. Section 2.1 defines DAP generically but does not supply its dataset-specific construction for CF; the table-note formula also leaves ib scaling relative to asset-scaled WC_ACC unresolved.

Figure 1 and Figure 2 seed amounts are reported as percentages of beginning total assets added to WC_ACC, which is itself scaled by lagged assets; the precise numeric scaling step is not explicit. The estimator for pooled regression fits is also unidentified.
results_review_notes: Table 1 Panel A summarizes the unseeded WC_ACC outcome in the full 209,530-observation sample. It is exact for the five Table 2 outcome specifications and a component of the seeded Figure 1–2 outcome.

Table 1 Panel C reports means and standard deviations for years t, t+1, and t+2 by earnings-performance decile. Only year-t summaries are linked to the frozen WC_ACC outcome; later years are outside the selected model horizon.
Table 1 Panel D is an AAER subsample descriptive and only its year-t WC_ACC row is linked; future accrual years are not part of the frozen outcome.
No descriptive-statistics rows are reported for the synthetic PART indicators or the ΔREV, PPE, and CF control terms in the selected model family; the relevant Table 1 panels summarize WC_ACC only.
